tasks.title: Build Core Snake Mechanics
tasks.instruction: Create a standalone Python module with class Snake and class Food for grid-based snake movement, direction handling, growth logic, and wall/self-collision checks.

tasks.title: Build Pygame GUI and Main Loop
tasks.instruction: Create the main entry point main.py using Pygame. Import snake_engine.py, handle keyboard inputs (Arrow keys), render Nokia-style green/black colors, draw grid, score, and handle Game Over reset.
